sloka: पिप्पलीनाम् च पक्वानाम् वनाद् अस्माद् उपागतः ।गन्धो अयम् पवन उत्क्षिप्तः सहसा कटुकोदयः ॥३-११-४९॥
transliteration: pippalīnām ca pakvānām vanād asmād upāgataḥ ।gandho ayam pavana utkṣiptaḥ sahasā kaṭukodayaḥ ॥3-11-49॥

translations.english: This is the glade we were told about with thousands of trees drooping down with abundant fruits and flowers.
